results.rationale: Consistency: the plain light background is preserved; column-count changes are the requested edit and excluded here. Instruction: all columns disappear, leaving zero instead of the required five. Quality: the edited image is a clean uniform light field without rendering artifacts; absence of requested objects is assessed under instruction, not visual quality.

Consistency: floor perspective and right loose stone remain, but the existing wall surface is entirely replaced with block masonry and the left loose stone is removed. Instruction: the large central hole remains open; changing the wall texture does not complete the missing section. Quality: coherent masonry blocks, rough opening edges, floor and lighting with no distracting artifacts.
